description: This Java class handles update commands for reports in the Fineract system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes update requests via the processCommand method, and delegates the update operation to the ReportWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UpdateReportCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles update report commands, processes the command, and delegates the update to the write platform service.

methods.name: UpdateReportCommandHandler (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the handler with the ReportWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes an update report command by invoking the updateReport method on the write platform service.
